facts.text: "Two best cops in Los Angeles and neither will admit the other one cooks better. Tonight we find out, Tango."
facts.why: Cash never says this. It is in quote marks and signed Gabe Cash, so it reads as a film line. A real Cash line is the Rambo one. It is crude, so check it suits the menu. No quote page for this film could be opened, so this is from memory.
Attached to the LA street tacos. Cash is an East LA cop, but the plot page I read has no chase across East LA, only the prison break, the club and the attack on Perret's hideout in the RV.

vibe.verdict: A generic prison canteen that skips the drag scene, the armoured RV and the buddy cop banter.
missing: Cash disguised as a woman at the Cleopatra Club (Kiki's club)
The armoured RV storming Perret's hideout (the finish)
Rambo is a pussy (Cash in the prison yard)
Tango's Cadillac and his stock tips (Tango's day job)
The hall of mirrors showdown with Perret (the hideout)
Cash zip lining over the prison wall (the escape)
ideas: Swap 'Prison canteen sandwiches' for 'Cleopatra Club cucumber sandwiches, Cash's cover'.
Swap the made up Cash note for a real Cash line.
Swap 'Breakout glazed meatloaf and mash' for 'Armoured RV roast, cooked in the back'.
Retitle 'Block C: Rival Cops Welcome' to 'West LA versus East LA' to match the rivalry.
